up: Retrieve all activity records and compound structures for assay CHEMBL1614174. For each matching activity, return the assay ID, molecule ChEMBL ID, activity type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, and pChEMBL value. Also include the canonical SMILES for each compound.
sql:
SELECT
  a.assay_id,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.pchembl_value,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614174');
